question.text: Will the World Health Organization prequalify moxidectin before December 15, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if, before December 15, 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO) adds moxidectin to its prequalification (PQ) [list](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/medicines/prequalified/finished-pharmaceutical-products), according to official WHO announcements or other [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/help/faq/#definitions). If this does not occur before that date, this question resolves as **No**.
question.fine_print:
Note that this question resolves **Yes** only if moxidectin achieves PQ approval for the treatment of onchocerciasis. If moxidectin achieves PQ approval for another indication, but not onchocerciasis, this question resolves as **No**.

Although Medicines Development for Global Health (MDGH) is developing moxidectin for potential WHO PQ, this question resolves regardless of which entity achieves the PQ.

research:
I found no evidence that WHO has prequalified moxidectin, and no public sign that a decision is close. I also couldn't confirm that a finished-product dossier has been submitted.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-01: The WHO list of prequalified finished pharmaceutical products page loaded (status 200). Its text contains no line matching "moxidectin" or "onchocerc". The CSV export behind the list returned HTTP 403, so I couldn't search the full data file. The page may only show part of the list, so this check is strong but not complete. [WHO PQ FPP list](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/medicines/prequalified/finished-pharmaceutical-products)
- 2026-11-01: The WHO prequalification news RSS feed has no moxidectin item. Its latest items are 2026-10-01 (eCTD submissions through the ePQS portal), 2026-08-28 (save-the-date for a manufacturers' meeting) and 2026-08-07 (IVD listings). [WHO PQ RSS](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/rss.xml)

## 2. Current status
- Not settled. As of 2026-11-01, I found no WHO or MDGH announcement of prequalification.
- I found no public confirmation that MDGH has filed a finished-product dossier, or that one is under assessment.
- The 2025 Essential Medicines List (EML) application said WHO PQ engagement was "ongoing" and that MDGH was "considering" the full assessment route. [EML proposal](https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/2025-eml-expert-committee/addition-of-new-medicines/a.20_moxidectin.pdf?sfvrsn=811cf48b_6), [EML review](https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/2025-eml-expert-committee/expert-reviews/a.20_moxidectin_review1.pdf?sfvrsn=7d28be3e_1)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-01: MDGH released its 2025 Annual Report, saying more than 110,000 people in Ghana have received moxidectin. The summary page does not mention prequalification. [MDGH](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/news/2025-annual-report)
- 2026-05-07: Healthbeat says the real-world rollout is only now under way in Ghana and that "Countries and the WHO still have to review the data and issue guidance." It says nothing about prequalification. [Healthbeat](https://www.healthbeat.org/2026/05/07/global-health-checkup-moxidectin-river-blindness-ai-insurance-hantavirus-cruise/)
- 2026-04-28: Nature reports a "long permissions process with the WHO and various national health authorities" and says some countries are reluctant to pay, because Merck donates ivermectin for free. It gives no prequalification date. [Nature](https://www.nature.com/articles/d44148-026-00110-2)
- 2026-04-06: WHO PQ published "Notes on the design of bioequivalence study: moxidectin". This is guidance for generic (multisource) makers, and it shows WHO treats moxidectin as an eligible product. [WHO PQ guidance](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/medicines/who-medicines-prequalification-guidance)
- 2025: Moxidectin was added to the WHO Essential Medicines List as an alternative to ivermectin for onchocerciasis (it is also listed for lymphatic filariasis). [EML](https://list.essentialmeds.org/medicines/963/print?format=pdf)
- 2025-03-18: According to a search summary, WHO added moxidectin to its call for active-ingredient (API) applications. I did not verify this directly. [WHO PQ news](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/news/38th-invitation-active-pharmaceutical-ingredients-apis)
- 2025-02-20: The US FDA extended the moxidectin approval to children aged 4 and older. [MDGH](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/news/u-s-fda-expands-indication-for-moxidectin-to-treat-river-blindness-in-patients-as-young-as-four)
- 2024-12-12: WHO reported that Ghana's Food and Drugs Authority approved moxidectin. [WHO](https://www.who.int/news/item/12-12-2024-moxidectin-approved-by-the-ghana-food-and-drugs-authority-a-new-milestone-in-the-fight-against-river-blindness)
- 2024-10-29: WHO's 9th invitation to submit neglected tropical disease (NTD) medicines added moxidectin for onchocerciasis. [WHO PQ news](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/news?page=4), [EOI annex](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/sites/default/files/document_files/Annex_EOI-NTD-v9_15Oct2024_minor%20revision.pdf)

## 4. Base rates
- Moxidectin has been FDA-approved since 2018. More than eight years later it is still not prequalified, so it has missed every past target.
- An earlier Metaculus question asked about prequalification before 2025-04-01, which implies that milestone passed without it. One search snippet says WHO "unexpectedly required extensive extra clinical trials", which I did not verify. [Metaculus](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/34283/will-the-world-health-organization-prequalify-moxidectin-before-april-1-2025)
- A full WHO assessment of a new product typically takes many months to over a year from dossier acceptance. I did not find an official median for this. With no public evidence of a submission, a listing within the remaining 6 weeks looks unlikely.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2024-06: GiveWell put an 80% chance on MDGH getting WHO prequalification by the end of 2026. That estimate predates the delays above and has no public update. [GiveWell](https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/medicines-development-for-global-health-moxidectin-who-pre-qualification-grant-june-2024)
- Metaculus has a related question, "before 2027". I could not read its community forecast (the page returned 403). [Metaculus](https://metaculus.com/questions/28395/will-who-prequalify-moxidectin-by-2027)
- None of the prediction-market prices you supplied (Kalshi, Polymarket) relate to this question. I found no Manifold market.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-12-15
- WHO PQ updates its list as products are approved, usually with little warning. A listing would show up on the list page and probably in the news/RSS feed.
- MDGH planned an end-of-2026 workshop under the GiveWell grant. [GiveWell](https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/medicines-development-for-global-health-moxidectin-who-pre-qualification-grant-june-2024)
- The American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene (ASTMH) annual meeting, usually held in November, is a typical place for MDGH updates. I did not confirm the 2026 dates.
- I found no scheduled WHO decision date.

Gaps: I couldn't read the full prequalification CSV (403), the 2025 WHO prequalification department annual report (the PDF text wouldn't parse), or the Metaculus community forecasts.

I found no evidence that WHO has prequalified moxidectin as of 2026-11-01. MDGH's own goal was prequalification by the end of 2026, but no public source shows a dossier submission or a WHO decision.

### 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-01: I searched the raw HTML of WHO's [prequalified finished pharmaceutical products list](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/medicines/prequalified/finished-pharmaceutical-products). The first page shows "Displaying: 1 - 50 of 659" and contains no "moxidectin". Adding a search parameter to the URL didn't filter the list, so I couldn't check the other 13 pages directly.
- 2026-11-01: The list's CSV export returned HTTP 403, and WHO's "under assessment" pages returned 404. So I couldn't confirm from WHO data whether a moxidectin dossier is under assessment.
- 2026-11-01: WHO's prequalification RSS feed has no moxidectin item. Its recent entries are about the ePQS submission portal (mandatory use announced 11 May 2026), a measles vaccine and fee adjustments. [RSS](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/rss.xml)

### 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. I found no WHO or MDGH announcement of prequalification.
- 2026-07-01: MDGH's 2025 annual report post mentions moxidectin's Essential Medicines List listing but says nothing about a prequalification submission, its timing or status. [MDGH](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/news/2025-annual-report)
- The sitemap of MDGH's news pages has no item about prequalification. [sitemap](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/sitemap.xml)

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-06-09: Cameroon launched a moxidectin project in Yaoundé, deploying it in the Bafia and Ntui health districts. [CRTV](https://actu.crtv.cm/?p=311142)
- 2026-04-06 (one search summary only, not verified): WHO's guidance page reportedly lists "Notes on the design of bioequivalence study: moxidectin (6 April 2026)". If true, WHO is updating guidance for other (generic) makers, which suggests the process is still active. [WHO PQ guidance](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/medicines/who-medicines-prequalification-guidance)
- 2026 (exact date unknown): A Nature article says the rollout involved "generation of additional data and a long permissions process with the WHO." The page is paywalled, so I couldn't read it. [Nature](https://www.nature.com/articles/d44148-026-00110-2)
- 2026-02-05: Results were posted for the large Phase 3b safety study comparing moxidectin with ivermectin (NCT04311671). [ClinicalTrials.gov](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04311671)
- 2025-12: WHO's comparator list for neglected tropical disease products names MDGH's moxidectin 2 mg tablet as the reference product. [WHO](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/sites/default/files/document_files/Comparator_NTD2025%20Dec.pdf)
- 2025: Moxidectin was added to WHO's Essential Medicines Lists for adults and children. That listing is separate from prequalification. An earlier review document said it was "Not yet prequalified, but engagement with WHO PQ team is ongoing." [MDGH](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/news/medicines-development-for-global-health-announces-inclusion-of-moxidectin-on-world-health-organization-essential-medicines-lists), [WHO review](https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/2025-eml-expert-committee/expert-reviews/a.20_moxidectin_review1.pdf?sfvrsn=7d28be3e_1)
- 2024-12-12: Ghana's FDA approved moxidectin for people aged 4 and older. [WHO](https://www.who.int/news/item/12-12-2024-moxidectin-approved-by-the-ghana-food-and-drugs-authority-a-new-milestone-in-the-fight-against-river-blindness)
- 2024-10-29: WHO published its revised 9th invitation for neglected tropical disease products, now including moxidectin. [WHO PQ](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/news/revised-ntd-eoi-published)
- 2024-10-24: WHO issued notes on bioequivalence study design for moxidectin. [WHO PQ](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/sites/default/files/document_files/be_moxidectin_oct-2024.pdf)

### 4. Base rates
- Moxidectin has had an open WHO invitation since October 2024, about 24 months, and is still not prequalified.
- 2018: FDA approval. 2024-12: Ghana approval. Each step has taken years. [MDGH](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/news/u-s-fda-approves-moxidectin-for-the-treatment-of-river-blindness)
- Since the product is FDA-approved, an abbreviated WHO route might be possible, which would usually be faster. I found no confirmation of which route applies or whether a dossier has been filed.
- A Metaculus question asked whether WHO would prequalify moxidectin before 2025-04-01. That date passed without prequalification. [Metaculus](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/34283/will-the-world-health-organization-prequalify-moxidectin-before-april-1-2025)

### 5. Other forecasts
- 2024-06: GiveWell's internal forecast gave an 80% chance that MDGH gets WHO prequalification by the end of 2026. This is old and predates the delays. [GiveWell](https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/medicines-development-for-global-health-moxidectin-who-pre-qualification-grant-june-2024)
- There is a Metaculus question "Will WHO prequalify moxidectin before 2027?" (28395). A search snippet put its community forecast at 92%. A different snippet said comments note WHO "unexpectedly required extensive extra clinical trials." The page returned 403, so I couldn't verify either claim or get the current figure. [Metaculus](https://metaculus.com/questions/28395/will-who-prequalify-moxidectin-by-2027)
- None of the Kalshi or Polymarket markets you supplied are relevant. I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this question.

### 6. Upcoming events before 2026-12-15
- WHO adds new entries to the prequalified list on a rolling basis, with no fixed decision dates. Any listing would show up there and probably in an MDGH press release.
- GiveWell planned a second MDGH workshop at the end of the grant period (late 2026), which might reveal status. [GiveWell](https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/medicines-development-for-global-health-moxidectin-who-pre-qualification-grant-june-2024)
- WHO filarial treatment guidelines covering moxidectin were expected in "early 2026". I couldn't confirm they have been published.
- The ASTMH annual meeting (usually November) is a likely place for MDGH or WHO updates. I didn't verify the 2026 dates.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 6 weeks remain, from 2026-11-01 to 2026-12-15. For Yes, WHO must add moxidectin (any manufacturer) to its prequalified finished pharmaceutical products list for onchocerciasis before December 15, 2026, confirmed by an official listing or credible reports.

(b) Status quo: moxidectin is not prequalified, and there is no public evidence that a dossier is under assessment. If nothing changes, the answer is No.

(c) Base rate: moxidectin has been FDA-approved since 2018 and has missed every earlier prequalification target, including the end-of-Q1-2025 milestone. For any given 6-week window, the chance that an innovator NTD product with no visible pending assessment gets listed is low, roughly 3-5%. The SRA-abridged pathway (for products already approved by a stringent regulator such as the FDA) can finish in roughly 3-6 months from submission. So a quiet submission in mid-2026 could still produce a listing in this window.

(d) Evidence for Yes:
- GiveWell's 2024-06 estimate put an 80% chance on MDGH getting prequalification by end of 2026, under a grant targeting that date.
- WHO added moxidectin to its 9th NTD invitation to manufacturers (2024-10).
- WHO added moxidectin to its call for API applications (2025-03, not directly verified).
- Moxidectin joined the Essential Medicines List in 2025.
- WHO published bioequivalence guidance for moxidectin (2026-04-06).
- Ghana's regulator approved moxidectin (2024-12) and rollout there is under way.

Evidence for No:
- As of 2026-11-01, the list and the RSS feed show no moxidectin.
- MDGH's 2025 annual report (2026-07) does not mention prequalification.
- Nature (2026-04) describes a "long permissions process" with WHO.
- The 2025 Essential Medicines List application said MDGH was only "considering" the full assessment route.
- There is no public confirmation that a dossier was ever submitted.

(e) No scenario: MDGH's dossier is either unsubmitted or still under assessment because of data questions, and the listing slips into 2027. Yes scenario: MDGH quietly filed through the abridged pathway in mid-2026, and WHO lists the product in late November or early December to meet the grant timeline.

(f) I start at about 4% for an unannounced listing in a 6-week window. I nudge up slightly for the end-of-2026 grant target and WHO's clear groundwork in 2024-2026. I hold down for the absence of any filing signal and the history of delays. My estimate is about 5%.

Probability: 5%

(a) There are about 6 weeks left, from 2026-11-01 to 2026-12-15. For Yes, WHO must add moxidectin to its list of prequalified finished pharmaceutical products, for onchocerciasis, before December 15, 2026.

(b) The status quo is No. As of 2026-11-01, moxidectin is not on the PQ list, and the PQ news feed has no announcement.

(c) Base rate: moxidectin has missed every past prequalification target since its 2018 FDA approval. That includes the earlier Metaculus question with an April 2025 deadline. For a product that has no public evidence of a dossier under assessment, the chance of being listed in any given 6-week window is low, around 3-5%. The abbreviated route for products already approved by a stringent regulator such as the FDA can take about 3 months, so a quiet filing could in principle finish this year.

(d) Evidence:
- For Yes:
  - In June 2024, GiveWell funded MDGH specifically to reach prequalification and put an 80% chance on it happening by the end of 2026.
  - In October 2024, WHO added moxidectin to its invitation for neglected tropical disease medicines.
